en: Black‑and‑white photograph of the interior of a traditional wooden log house with exposed beams and plank floor. A large white masonry hearth or oven sits in the middle against a log wall, with wooden benches and tools around it. On the left stands a spinning wheel and a simple wooden chair; on the right are long poles or ladders leaning against the wall. Through an open doorway another room with a table and a large window can be seen. Captions in a Scandinavian language are printed at the bottom of the image.
